en: Stylized winter cityscape illustration showing a snow‑covered square or street. In the foreground are bushes and trees laden with snow, with several small figures walking or standing in the snow. To the left stands an older, lower building with a steep snow‑covered roof and small towers or spires. Behind it, dominating the center, is a tall rectangular multi‑story block that looks like a mid‑20th‑century apartment or office building. To the right are additional snow‑covered buildings and a red vehicle that resembles a trolleybus or tram. The palette is mainly gray, black, and white with small red accents. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
